summary: Iteration 94 — Tested Card 4 Foundation Builder (backend + frontend) and the new /dashboard landing (welcome image replaces 'A Brighter Future' banner, 3 hotspots). All 10 backend tests pass (3 unit + 7 HTTP). All 6 frontend acceptance areas pass: landing layout/order/overflow, image load (sa-welcome-768.webp, naturalWidth=390, alt text present), hero removed, hotspots open Self/Court/BIFF correctly with aria-labels, Card 4 autosave pending→saved, PDF download, saved badges on tile + access button, persistence after reload, and legacy mediation foundation-statement endpoint still reachable.

minor.issue: Content-Disposition filename uses sanitized parent_names; when empty it falls back to literal 'me' (SA_CoParents_Foundation_Statement_me.pdf). Spec says '<name>' — fallback is reasonable but worth documenting.

issues: The 'Welcome to SA CoParents / Take the next step to build a safer, calmer, and more child-focused future.' banner (A Brighter Future-style) is still rendered inside Self Journey sub-view below the card grid. Spec said replace it on LANDING only — present behaviour is correct per the request, flagging for awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: foundation_builder_routes.py is small, clean, async-correct, excludes _id in GET projection, caps field length (3000), drops unknown keys — looks good.
PUT /me overwrites by setting the entire fields dict ($set), which matches the 'keep only latest / overwrite' spec. Confirmed via test_put_me_overwrite_replaces.
Lockstep JSON copy test (frontend/src/pages/portal/foundationBuilderContent.json ≡ backend/foundation_builder_content.json) is in place and passing.
POST /pdf is public by design (localStorage-first portal) — comment documents this intentionally.

Clicking court hotspot opens the Court Ordered sub-view (A/B/C cards: Child Needs, Co-Parenting Dynamics, Conflict Readiness). Clicking self hotspot opens Self Journey with Card 4 (foundation). Card 4: foundation-save-status data-status transitions pending→saved on autosave while signed in; foundation-save closes dialog; filename returned 'SA_CoParents_Foundation_Statement.pdf' (name-less fallback). Safety First strip (text 'Safety First Private · DV & IPV check') and Quick Exit (data-testid='door-quick-exit') are present on Self Journey, Court view, and Foundation view.
